subject: Re: Joint 'Embed & Scale' workshop + micro-articles (San Francisco satellite event)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Zhao <claire@orchidtools.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Joint workshop + blog swap idea (San Francisco satellite)

Hi Claire —

Great meeting you briefly at the Summit partner reception last week. Orchid Tools' work on embedding performance for retrieval-heavy apps felt like a really natural fit with what our field team is seeing.

We'd love to run a co-hosted "Embed & Scale" satellite workshop the week of Nov 16 in San Francisco (90 minutes, small invite-only format) that pairs a short technical talk from Orchid on retrieval optimizations with a hands-on Redwood demo showing quantization + caching wins.

High-level proposal: 
- 30 min: Orchid technical talk (Samir)
- 45 min: Redwood hands-on demo + troubleshooting lab (Jordan)
- 15 min: Q&A + next-steps

We can also do a two-part co-marketing push:
- Blog swap (guest post from Orchid on our dev blog about embeddings)
- Joint registration page + email to our SF-based field list (we'll cover paid social)

I attached a quick proposed agenda and a short partner bio for you and Samir. If Orchid is interested, can you confirm: 
1) Your preferred dates the week of Nov 16 (we're flexible on Tue/Wed)
2) Who will be the primary speaker(s) and whether you need any hardware/AV support
3) Any co-marketing commitments you prefer (blog bylines, social cross-posts, logo placement)

Happy to jump on a short call this week to sync logistics.

Thanks —
Marissa
Director, Field Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed-agenda.pdf (1 page), partner-bio.docx (1 page)

From: Claire Zhao <claire@orchidtools.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Joint workshop + blog swap idea (San Francisco satellite)

Marissa —

Thanks for the note and the agenda — excited by the idea. Nov 17 or Nov 18 both work for Samir and me. He can cover the retrieval optimization piece and I can do a short customer case intro.

A few questions from our side: 
- Is the session for ~40 engineers or a smaller 15-20 workshop? (We prefer hands-on, so 20 max is ideal.)
- Do you have a standard co-marketing checklist (assets, timelines, approvals)?

We can commit to a guest blog post (800–1,000 words) and a social cross-post. We may also be able to bring one customer who uses Orchid + Redwood for a 5–7 minute case snippet — I'll confirm if they're comfortable.

If you want to lock a time, I'm free for a 20-min sync on Mon afternoon.

Best,
Claire Zhao
Head of Partnerships
Orchid Tools
